adjudication.rationale: In `GoogleCalendarService.updateEvent`, `selectedCalendar` is now computed as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When the ternary’s else branch runs, `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the condition failed), so the `.find()` predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` against a falsy value (typically `undefined`/`null`) and will not match a real calendar externalId. This breaks the prior behavior (`: event.destinationCalendar?.externalId`) and makes `selectedCalendar` effectively always `undefined` in the fallback path, so the update will not target the intended destination calendar (and may pass an undefined calendarId depending on the unchanged call site).
